nodes.description: Constructor of EVEExchangeERC20: sets up contract id, grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and PREDICATE_ROLE, mints 100,000,000 EVE and initializes EIP712 domain.
External mint(address user, uint256 amount) restricted by only(PREDICATE_ROLE); delegates supply creation to ERC20._mint.
Overridden _msgSender() that returns ContextMixin.msgSender(), resolving meta-transaction callers from calldata.
Returns msg.sender, or if the caller is the contract itself, decodes the trailing 20 bytes of msg.data as the original sender.
Payable meta-transaction entry point: builds the MetaTransaction, verifies the EIP712 signature, bumps the nonce, emits MetaTransactionExecuted and performs a low-level call back into address(this).
Internal view that requires a non-zero signer and compares it with ecrecover over the EIP712 typed message hash.
Hashes the MetaTransaction struct (nonce, from, keccak256(functionSignature)) with META_TRANSACTION_TYPEHASH.
Public view returning the current nonce of a user from the nonces mapping.
Internal minting primitive: validates the destination, runs the transfer hook, increases total supply and balance using SafeMath.add.
Internal transfer primitive: validates addresses, calls the before-transfer hook, subtracts from sender and adds to recipient using SafeMath.
Internal approval primitive: validates owner and spender and writes the allowance mapping.
Grants a role after requiring that _msgSender() holds the role's admin role.
Revokes a role after requiring that _msgSender() holds the role's admin role.
Allows the caller to renounce a role; requires account == _msgSender().
Public view checking whether an account is a member of a role's AddressSet.
Internal unchecked role assignment used during initialization.
bytes32 public constant PREDICATE_ROLE = keccak256("PREDICATE_ROLE") used by the only(PREDICATE_ROLE) modifier on mint.
mapping(address => uint256) of meta-transaction nonces, read and incremented inside executeMetaTransaction.
Boolean guarding the initializer modifier so _initializeEIP712 can only run once.
Cached EIP712 domain separator derived from name, version, address(this) and chainid.
Revert message string set by _setupContractId and used by the only(role) modifier.
Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances, mutated by _transfer and _mint.
Private nested mapping holding spender allowances, mutated by _approve.
Private total supply value increased by _mint.
Caller-controlled address used for role checks, relayer emission and meta-transaction sender resolution.
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) executed after signature verification and nonce increment; forwards all gas to self.
Inline assembly that mloads the trailing 32 bytes of calldata and masks the lower 20 bytes to derive the meta-transaction sender.
ecrecover over the EIP712 typed message hash returning the alleged signer address.
mint(address user, uint256 amount) parameter: destination of newly minted tokens.
mint(address user, uint256 amount) parameter: amount of tokens to mint.
executeMetaTransaction parameter userAddress, used both as metaTx.from and as the recovered signer.
executeMetaTransaction parameter functionSignature, appended to the calldata of the self low-level call.
executeMetaTransaction parameter sigV forwarded to ecrecover.
verify parameter signer: address expected to equal the ecrecover result.
verify parameter metaTx: the MetaTransaction struct that is hashed and signature-checked.
grantRole/renounceRole parameter account: the grantee or renouncing account.
grantRole/revokeRole/renounceRole parameter role: the bytes32 role identifier being administered.

edges.reason: ContextMixin.msgSender returns msg.sender in the non-meta path and compares it to address(this).
msgSender falls back to inline assembly reading msg.data to extract the original sender address.
ERC20-facing _msgSender override delegates to ContextMixin.msgSender.
msg.sender is used as relayerAddress in the MetaTransactionExecuted event.
nonces[userAddress] is read to populate metaTx.nonce.
nonces[userAddress] is incremented by one after successful verification to prevent replay.
userAddress parameter flows into metaTx.from and into appended calldata.
functionSignature parameter flows into the MetaTransaction struct and the call encoding.
executeMetaTransaction performs the low-level self-call that constitutes the unsafe operation.
functionSignature is concatenated with userAddress to form the calldata of the low-level call.
The all-gas low-level call into address(this) lets an attacker re-enter executeMetaTransaction, which is not guarded and updates nonces only after verification.
executeMetaTransaction requires verify(...) to succeed before any state change.
userAddress is passed as the expected signer to verify.
The MetaTransaction struct is hashed and signature-checked in verify.
metaTx fields are abi.encoded inside hashMetaTransaction.
hashMetaTransaction output is wrapped by toTypedMessageHash and consumed by verify's ecrecover.
verify calls ecrecover with the typed message hash and signature components.
sigV parameter is forwarded to ecrecover.
The address returned by ecrecover is compared against the expected signer.
domainSeperator is used to build the EIP712 typed message hash consumed by verify.
getNonce returns nonces[user] from the nonces state variable.
mint is protected by the only(PREDICATE_ROLE) modifier referencing the PREDICATE_ROLE constant.
The only(role) modifier resolves PREDICATE_ROLE membership through hasRole.
_msgSender() (derived from msg.sender/calldata) is the account queried by hasRole in the access-control modifier.
mint delegates token creation to ERC20._mint after the role check passes.
user parameter is forwarded from mint.
amount parameter is forwarded from mint.
user becomes the account credited by _mint.
amount becomes the minted quantity in _mint.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add; unsafe arithmetic only if the SafeMath wrapper is bypassed.
_mint reads _totalSupply as the left operand of the SafeMath addition.
_mint credits _balances[account] using SafeMath.add.
_mint reads the current balance before adding the minted amount.
role parameter determines which role's admin role must be held before granting.
grantRole requires hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()).
account parameter is the grantee passed to _grantRole.
grantRole continues through the internal role-granting path used by _setupRole.
_setupRole grants membership tracked and queried by hasRole.
The _msgSender() override supplies the admin account checked inside grantRole.
revokeRole requires hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()).
renounceRole requires account == _msgSender().
account parameter is compared against _msgSender() in renounceRole.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] before SafeMath.sub(amount).
_transfer writes the debited and credited balances back into the _balances mapping.
_approve writes into the _allowances nested mapping.
_approve updates _allowances[owner][spender] with the approved amount.
The constructor assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and PREDICATE_ROLE through _setupRole.
The constructor mints the initial 100,000,000 EVE supply via _mint.
The constructor calls _initializeEIP712, whose initializer modifier flips the inited flag.
_initializeEIP712 sets the domainSeperator state variable used for meta-transaction signatures.

normalization_plan.reason: user is a non-core parameter of mint and should be folded into the mint core function node.
amount is a non-core parameter of mint and should be folded into the mint core function node.
userAddress is a non-core parameter of executeMetaTransaction and should be folded into that core function node.
functionSignature is a non-core parameter of executeMetaTransaction and should be folded into that core function node.
sigV is a non-core parameter of executeMetaTransaction/verify, directly related to the verify core function.
signer is a non-core parameter of verify and should be folded into the verify core function node.
metaTx is a non-core parameter of verify and should be folded into the verify core function node.
account is a non-core parameter of grantRole/renounceRole, directly related to the grantRole core function.
role is a non-core parameter used by the AccessControl role-administration functions and should be folded into grantRole.
